import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long INF = 1000000000L;
    static long n;
    static long[] a = new long[18];

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextLong();

        a[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < 18; i++) {
            a[i] = a[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
        }

        System.out.println(compute(n, 17));
        sc.close();
    }

    static long compute(long m, int idx) {
        long total = (m / a[idx]) * (idx + 1);
        m %= a[idx];
        if (m == 0) return total;
        return total + Math.min((long)(idx + 1) + compute(a[idx] - m, idx - 1), compute(m, idx - 1));
    }
}
